pages.text: Cutting uses exactly $(item)1 cured leaf$() and $(item)1 Chaveta$() placed orthogonally beside each other in a crafting grid. One cured leaf becomes $(item)3 loose tobacco$(). The Chaveta's location relative to the leaf determines the cut.

Relative to the $(item)leaf$():$(br2)$(thing)Chaveta above$() → Shag Cut$(br)$(thing)Chaveta left$() → Ribbon Cut$(br)$(thing)Chaveta right$() → Rough Cut$(br)$(thing)Chaveta below$() → Flake Cut$(br2)Diagonal placement does not work.
